SHANGHAI, May 31, 1932.

The Superintendent of Police,
The Shanghai Municipal Police,
Criminal Investigation Department,
Administration Building,
Shanghai.

Dear Sir,

Re: s.s. "Elizabeth Moller"
Disappearance of Chinese Watchman
AND Supervisory Indian Watchman.
------------------------------------

We place at your disposal two certified copies
of reports issued by Captain S. E. Pearce and Chief Officer
G. H. Ramsay of our s.s. "Elizabeth Moller" surrounding the
disappearance of our two Watchmen, which took place during
the night of 29th. May, after these two men had gone on
watch on our vessel at about 7 p.m.

We are inclined to believe that foul play has
occurred, and therefore we take this opportunity of bringing
this to your attention.

We would advise you that we have written to:-

|| The H.M.B. Consulate, Shipping Department and
   The Shanghai River Police, care of the Harbour Master.

Yours faithfully,
MOLLER & COMPANY
Eric Moller
Manager.
Agents for s.s. "Elizabeth Moller"

现将我方蒸汽船“Elizabeth Moller”号船长 S. E. Pearce 和大副 G. H. Ramsay 就两名更夫失踪一事所出具的报告之认证副本两份呈交贵处查阅。该两名更夫于5月29日晚约7时登轮值勤后，于当夜失踪。

我方倾向于认为已发生恶性犯罪，故借此机会提请贵处注意。

谨告知贵处，我方已致函：

|| 英国驻华领事馆航运部，及
   由港务长转交的上海水上警察。

此致，

May 30th                                                                 2

S.S. "ELIZABETH MOLLER"
lying alongside "International Dock"

Messrs. Moller & Co.,                                9 a.m.
PRESENT.

Dear Sirs:-

Missing Chinese Watchman
AND
Missing Supervisory Indian Watchman.

In regard to the above missing watchmen, as requested
by your office, I beg to make the following report:-

On Sunday morning the 29th instant at about 8 a.m.
I was informed by the Indian Head watchman at the "International Dock"
that both the Chinese night watchman and the Indian Supervisory watchman
employed on our vessel were missing since the previous night.

This "International Dock" watchman informed me that
the head No.1 Indian watchman had visited our vessel at about 8 p.m.
the previous night, as was his usual practice, and that since such time
neither of the two (2) men had been seen.

The "International Dock" Indian watchman suggested
that both of the missing men have been very probably murdered, and that
in his opinion the crime was committed and or instigated by an ex member
of our steamer's crew, i.e., the 2nd boatswain named Yao Tse Yung
who was dismissed on the 23rd instant on account of being caught in the
act of stealing paint.

This particular boatswain has been caught by the missing
Indian watchman Shakeer Kahn in the act of passing a drum of paint over
the vessel's side.

The Chief No.1 Indian watchman informed me that this
2nd boatswain was chased along the Dock wharf, caught and identified as
the actual thief.

Under the guidance of Captain E.E. Pearce, I was requested

蒸汽船“ELIZABETH MOLLER”号

莫勒公司诸位先生，                                上午9时
在场。

尊敬的先生们：

中国更夫失踪
及
印度监管更夫失踪。

关于上述失踪的更夫，应贵处要求，谨作如下报告：

本月29日（星期日）上午约8时，我接到“国际码头”的印度领班更夫通知，称受雇于我方船只的中国夜班更夫和印度监管更夫自前一夜起便已失踪。

该“国际码头”更夫告知我，印度一号领班更夫曾于前一夜约晚8时按惯例访问我方船只，自那时起，这两名人员均未再被看见。

该“国际码头”印度更夫推测，这两名失踪人员极有可能已被谋杀，且他认为该罪行系由我方轮船的一名前船员实施或唆使，即二水姚子荣（Yao Tse Yung，音译），此人因偷窃油漆当场被抓，于本月23日被解雇。

这名特定的二水曾被失踪的印度更夫沙基尔·汗（Shakeer Kahn，音译）当场抓获，当时他正将一桶油漆递过船舷。

印度一号领班更夫告知我，这名二水在码头沿岸被追赶、抓获，并被确认为实际窃贼。

在 E.E. Pearce 船长的指导下，我被要求

to inform the police immediately, which was attended to with all
possible haste.

The night watchman usual came on duty every evening at
about 7 p.m.

During the present overhaul of my vessel the s.s. "Elizabeth
Moller" I have slept on board of the ship, but recently owing to the
alterations of the officers' accommodations I was staying on board of
one of the Company's other vessels, the s.s. "Therese Moller", which
was then lying in drydock at the "International Dock".

.......oooooOoooo.......

Later about Noon.

I regret to further report to the office that about Noon
to-day the body of the Chinese watchman came to surface of the river
close under the stern of our vessel after certain dragging operations
have been taken place under the supervision of the Indian watchman.

The body of the deceased Chinese night watchman was
forthwith handed over to the River Police.

......ooooOooooo......

Later 3 p.m.

Up to the time of my leaving the s.s. "Elizabeth Moller"
to report to this office, there was no further information surrounding
the missing Indian watchman.

I am not in a position to give you guidance regarding
the conduct of my Chinese Crew, as at no time has any misconduct
been brought to my attention.

I remain,
Dear Sirs,
Yours faithfully,

〔签名〕

Chief Officer s.s. "Elizabeth Moller"

CERTIFIED
TRUE-COPY
SHANGHAI, 31/5.32
MOLLER AND COMPANY

副本

立即通知警方，此事已尽可能迅速地得到处理。

夜班更夫通常于每晚约7时上岗。

在我方蒸汽船“Elizabeth Moller”号目前进行大修期间，我本住在船上，但最近由于军官住宿区的改动，我住在了公司另一艘停泊于“国际码头”干船坞内的蒸汽船“Therese Moller”号上 ____ oooooOoooo ____

稍后，约中午时分。

我很遗憾地向贵处进一步报告，约今日中午，在经过若干拖捞作业后，中国更夫的尸体在我方船尾附近的河面浮出，上述作业是在印度更夫的监督下进行的。

 deceased 中国夜班更夫的遗体随即移交给水上警察 ____ ooooOooooo ____

稍后，下午3时。

直至我离开蒸汽船“Elizabeth Moller”号前来向贵处报告时，关于失踪的印度更夫尚无更多消息。

我无法就我方中国船员的行为向贵处提供指导，因为从未有任何不当行为引起我的注意。

此致，
尊敬的先生们，
您忠实的，

〔签名〕

蒸汽船“Elizabeth Moller”号大副

经核证
真实副本
上海，1932年5月31日

June 1st, 2.

Gentlemen,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your letter
C. 1195 and enclosures of May 31, 1932 regarding the
disappearance of a Chinese Watchman and Supervisory
Indian Watchman from the s.s. "Elizabeth Moller" and
to inform you that the matter is receiving attention.

I am, Gentlemen,
Your obedient servant,

（印：CRIME BRANCH / CENTRAL POLICE STATION / SHANGHAI）
Deputy Commissioner (Crime).

12 The Bund.
